answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity counts as real only after exchanges with 12 distinct counterparties in 20 epochs, blocking forged identities trading only in-ring. A wharf clerk counts ships, not crates: 100 trades with one partner count as one. A two-partner ring is flagged: like karst, solid above yet hollow below. Reaching 12 counterparties costs 24 POA, so 100 fakes cost 2,400 POA; an honest agent pays 24 POA once, keeps rewards.
